svg.title: Camera mounting · chassis lip — good and bad mounting
svg.desc: Camera at the chassis edge: clearance area free. Recessed camera: the chassis lip obstructs the lower clearance area. The shaded volume represents clearance, not the optical field of view. Not to scale.
svg.text: Shaded volume: clearance area · Red marks: obstruction · Not to scale
